spec.name: t4: pointer lookup G[last][x[ptr(last)]] via mlp0 -> 1.2 -> mlp1
spec.code:
def predict(tokens, prompt):
    # ids: 0 BOS, 2 fu, 3 ko, 4 la, 5 nu, 6 vo
    last = tokens[6]
    # mlp0 at the last position: last token -> pointer (E0012, E0016, E0017)
    j = 2 if last in (2, 3) else 1
    # head 1.2 reads the token at that position (E0007, E0008)
    b = tokens[j]
    # mlp1 looks up (last, selected) -> output (E0011); table read off E0001
    G = {2: {2: 3, 3: 5, 4: 6, 5: 6, 6: 3},
         3: {2: 5, 3: 3, 4: 4, 5: 4, 6: 5},
         4: {2: 5, 3: 6, 4: 6, 5: 6, 6: 5},
         5: {2: 5, 3: 4, 4: 2, 5: 4, 6: 3},
         6: {2: 5, 3: 6, 4: 4, 5: 6, 6: 5}}
    return G[last][b]
